Conclusions & Recommendations 7.1 Summary of Key Findings Table 6: Summary of Key Findings No. Finding Severity 1 Central BU accounts for 54.4% of total suppliers High 2 HCMC leads with 20.4% of national suppliers High 3 31.1% of SubDs have not migrated to DISLite Medium 4 89.6% SupplierID duplication (time-series) Needs review 5 5.08% orders delayed >5 days Medium 6 Mean delivery time: 1.34 days (fast) Good 7 Tiger + Heineken account for 81.2% of volume High 8 72.9% orders picked within the same day Good 7.2 Recommendations Data: Clarify the cause of SupplierID duplication (89.6%). If due to time-series, a composite primary key (supplierid + FOM) is needed. If a data quality issue, cleansing is required. Operations: 1,524 delayed orders (>5 days) require root cause analysis. DisCode 68351358 and 66702120 appear frequently in the delay list - operational review is needed at these points. Business: 31.1% of SubDs not yet on DISLite represent an expansion opportunity. Provinces outside the Top 10 have growth potential, especially mountainous provinces in the North. Product: The heavy dependence on Tiger and Heineken (81.2%) calls for portfolio diversification. New SKUs should be promoted to balance the product mix.
